metrics.waiver: OpenBB SDK v4.7.1 tested 2026-05-21 [REAL_API]. CBOE provider not available for options chains (only intrinio and yfinance). yfinance provider returns 905 contracts with IV and OI but no gamma column — GEX formula requires gamma directly. SAME_SOURCE=false (yfinance upstream is Yahoo Finance API, independent of cdn.cboe.com/api/global/delayed_quotes/options/GME.json). Independent source exists but lacks required Greek (gamma) for reconciliation. Deriving gamma from IV via Black-Scholes introduces model risk disqualifying it as independent verification.
